intro: Australia is one of the world's leading destinations for international students, known for its high-quality education, globally ranked universities, generous post-study work rights and strong part-time work allowances and wide range of study options.
why: High part-time earning potential during study
Regional study bonuses add extra stay-back time
visa: Subclass 500 Student visa — CoE, Genuine Student requirement, OSHC health cover and financial capacity evidence. International students generally apply for the Student visa (subclass 500). Key requirements include: Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE) from an eligible institution; evidence of financial capacity; ITRs of sponsors; English-language requirements, where applicable; Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC); Genuine Student assessment requirement; health and character assessments; valid passport and supporting documentation.
intakes: February and July are the two main intakes, with some November starts. Apply 6–9 months ahead.

req.label: English test
req.value: IELTS 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0

req.label: GS requirement
req.value: Genuine Student statement explaining course choice and plans

req.label: Documents
req.value: Marksheet, Resume, SOP/GS, LORs, transcripts, passport, OSHC, funds proof.

work: Student visa holders can work 48 hours a fortnight during study and unrestricted hours in breaks. The Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485) gives 2–3 years of post-study work rights, with extra time for regional study.

faq.q: What is the Genuine Student requirement?
faq.a: It is a mandatory requirement for international students applying for an Australian Student Visa (Subclass 500). The purpose is to assess whether the applicant genuinely intends to study in Australia and whether the proposed course makes sense in light of their academic background, circumstances and future plans.
It can help lower living costs, give extra post-study work time and additional PR points.

faq.q: Can I work full time after the course ends?
faq.a: Yes, once your course is complete and until your student visa expires.

faq.q: How much funds must I show?
faq.a: Tuition plus AUD 29,710 living costs, as required for subclass 500.
